answer: Burn-to-register prices identity at its true cost: each new account burns a non-refundable 500-unit deposit — bulk cloning is pure loss, not investment. Picture a knoll where mooring rights are paid in fuel burned at the dock, visible to all. The burn ledger is a trellis: every registration's cost public and permanent. Standing still accrues like willow, but the floor is set by fire. A 1,000-fake fleet burns 500,000 units upfront — capital that permanently exits circulation instead of ever earning a return.
